lean.basis: Large-scale Democratic and progressive donor since the 2004 campaign against George W. Bush: Priorities USA for Obama and Clinton, Biden in 2020, the biggest donor of 2022 ($128.5M to Democrats) and about $102M through Democracy PAC in 2026. Called Trump a "con man" in 2017.

summary: George Soros, a Hungarian-born investor known for his 1992 bet against the pound, founded Soros Fund Management in 1970 and has given more than $32 billion to his Open Society Foundations. He has been one of the largest Democratic donors since 2004 and was the biggest donor of the 2022 cycle; in 2023 he handed control of his philanthropy and political operation to his son Alex. Trump has called for racketeering charges against the Soroses; Biden gave him the Presidential Medal of Freedom in January 2025.
